name: How much water does a running toilet waste?

mainEntity.name: How much water does a running toilet waste?

acceptedAnswer.text: A continuously running toilet can waste a significant amount of water, leading to higher utility bills. Even a slow, undetectable leak can waste hundreds of gallons per day. A moderately running toilet can waste between 1 to 5 gallons per minute, which can translate to thousands of gallons per month. This wasted water not only impacts your wallet but also puts unnecessary strain on water resources. Promptly fixing a running toilet is important for both conservation and cost savings.
acceptedAnswer.description: A running toilet can waste hundreds to thousands of gallons of water per month, significantly increasing utility bills and impacting water conservation.
